name: Industrial Motherboards
description: Long-lifecycle industrial motherboards across ITX (170×170), 3.5", 2.5", NANO and NUC form factors. Wide CPU support from Intel Core Ultra and 12–14th Gen down to fanless Alder Lake-N, Elkhart Lake and domestic Feiteng platforms.
differentiators: Rich legacy I/O: up to 6× COM, LVDS/eDP

name: Embedded Box PCs
description: Fanless aluminium box PCs engineered for continuous 24/7 operation in dust, vibration and wide-temperature environments. Cableless internal design for shock resistance and field reliability.

name: NUC Mini PC Hosts
description: Small-form-factor NUC hosts balancing compute density and footprint for control terminals, signage players and edge nodes. Latest Intel Core Ultra and AMD Ryzen options.
differentiators: Intel Core Ultra / AMD Ryzen AI

name: Network Security Appliances
description: 1U rackmount and desktop network appliances with multi-port GbE, SFP fiber and bypass options for firewall, soft-router, VPN and edge-security deployments.

name: Industrial Panel PCs
description: All-metal, fanless touch panel PCs for HMI, machine-side control and outdoor-readable display. Panel-mount and VESA options with rich COM/GPIO I/O.

name: OPS Display Modules
description: Standard-slot OPS (Open Pluggable Specification) computing modules for interactive flat panels, education boards and conferencing displays. Hot-swappable JAE 80-pin interface.

name: All-in-One Computers
description: 23.8" integrated all-in-one workstations for reception, kiosk, education and light-industrial front-of-house deployments. Windows 11 ready.

name: Live Streaming Systems
description: Portable all-in-one live-streaming computers with rotating touchscreen and multi-signal HDMI switching for e-commerce, training and event broadcast.
